notes.title: Steam Sale & What's Been Happening
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Wanted to mention that Fatal Velocity is currently 70% off during the Steam Sale! If you already have a copy let your pals know so you can throw 'em under a train or into some turbines!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/3fbae75f8acd128ae27f5c78061ea518986ea927.png[/img]

[h1][u]What's Been Happening?[/u][/h1]

I want to keep everyone in the loop so they know where we've been and what's the future of Fatal Velocity.

(Where we've been)
- Dream Hack Austin 2018
- Positive feedback for the game & suggestions to improve
- Working on level design to standardize scale of maps and hazards
- Experimenting with weapon and gameplay design changes

(What's the future?)
- If new weapon and gameplay design changes work, expand upon original idea and keep growing the game's interest into the FPS genre
- Development will continue, but at a slower pace due to limited resources [b](1 developer working on this doesn't make it easy!)[/b]
- Community has shown some interest in tournaments [2 vs 2] or [3 vs 3]
- Explore the possibility of a solo exploration experience

If you haven't already, be sure to join our Discord for more community interaction! We're around 950 people and it would be f*cking AWESOME to hit 1,000 by July!!

[url=https://discord.gg/2wJqhP8][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/31a6e811c3d81efb7b3b080bcb88e92ffd7b562f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 808 Notes
notes.content:
Here are the latest changes to Fatal Velocity!

- New male armor to choose from
- Fixed hands de-syncing
- Jump animations should NOT play if weapons are being used
- Mines should credit kills if player who deployed them dies
- Reticle switching fixed
- Grapple/Pull beams should not shoot from the hips anymore
- Shift abilities break Grapple/Pull
- HUD bounces if hit by grenade
- If there are problems please post 
- New ammo bars along crosshair

If you come across any other bugs please let us know in Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/nV4yx6q][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/31a6e811c3d81efb7b3b080bcb88e92ffd7b562f.png[/img][/url]

Range.

notes.title: Update 798 Notes
notes.content:
- Scaled the strength multiplier on the Push Tech_ to be less OP
- Made the blast radius of the mine to be more accurate to it's particle representation
- Slow down the rising lava in the new 'Lava' map
- Spawn points in 'Lava' now teleport players to proper spawns depending on the lava's vertical position
- Implemented a new temporarily Push Grenade particle to improve it's visible blast radius

Range

notes.title: Fatal Velocity Heading To Pax East 2018!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/a7e99483a6ffb217c0f130475c27591d7c2c1148.jpg[/img]

There are only 63 days until we head out to PAX East (April 5-8). We're going for a few reasons: build the community, meet others and playtest the game for 4 days straight before we enter into Steam Early Access on April 18th! If you'll be attending PAX East please come by and say hello!

[h1][b](Booth 23099)[/b][/h1]

It finally feels like it's coming together. Our main focus from here on out is polish. Everything from the UI feedback, figuring out those pesky bugs, improving the art/particles and getting in a couple more maps before we officially launch! (And a few other things)...

If you haven't already please join our rapidly growing [b][url=https://discord.gg/2wJqhP8]Discord[/url][/b] community! 

                                                 [url=https://discord.gg/2wJqhP8][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/f5e31d9d75d57c46bac9b3f38c8020da36315d83.png[/img][/url]
